sanka.note: Hosted Sanka MCP server via the packaged local proxy. Claude Code starts plugin MCP servers in the session's working directory and ignores cwd, so the launcher path is anchored at the plugin root. On first use it signs in with standard MCP OAuth (it opens Sanka's consent page and keeps the tokens on this machine) and lets expense attachment tools read exact user-provided local receipt paths before forwarding original bytes to hosted Sanka MCP.
